capabilities: insert tracker modules into a note with one command
log daily check-ins by clicking a button
visualize streaks and annual progress in a heatmap
add, remove, or rearrange tracker blocks
choose week start and interface language
extras: README is bilingual (English and Simplified Chinese); check-ins are stored as plain text in the note so they remain searchable and editable.
motivation: The author wanted ultra-simple tracking with no setup or system building: insert modules with one command and log effort with a click.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to track daily habits or progress toward a single goal inside a note without building a system yourself.
summary: Habit and goal tracker that inserts ready-made check-in modules (buttons, streak overview, yearly heatmap, goal card) into any note.
